name: banza-target-registry
description: banza-target-registry (M2.19G.1, ADR-034): the CLOSED Technical Registry domain model + resolution/eligibility logic for endpoint-originated operator validation. It resolves operator_id -> implementation_id -> canonical_origin -> discovery over a closed set, decides eligibility (published/revoked/origin/compat/environment) in Rust, and aggregates Certification Readiness (READY/BLOCKED — never CERTIFIED). Presence in the registry never implies admission, authorisation, or the ability to move funds.
